description_en: Queries the status of asynchronous tasks associated with a specified AgentTeams instance, with pagination support
description_zh: 用于查询指定AgentTeams实例关联的异步任务状态，支持分页
name: GetInstanceAsyncTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentTeams instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The task code. If not specified, all asynchronous tasks are queried. You can pass in a `TaskCode` to filter results. To query multiple task types, submit separate requests.

Currently supported `taskCode` values include: `CreateInstance`, `RenewInstance`, `UpdateInstance`, `ReleaseInstance`, `ConfigureNatGateway`, `UpgradeInstance`, `CreateWorkerEndpoint`, and `DeleteWorkerEndpoint`.

Legacy task codes such as `LIFECYCLE_MAGIC_PAY_ORDER_CALLBACK_CREATE` are supported for backward compatibility, but `CreateInstance` is recommended
parameters.help_zh:
任务 Code。不传默认查询全部异步任务；支持传入`TaskCode` 进行过滤，多个任务类型需分别查询。

当前支持的 `taskCode` 包括：`CreateInstance`、`RenewInstance`、`UpdateInstance`、`ReleaseInstance`、`ConfigureNatGateway`、`UpgradeInstance`、`CreateWorkerEndpoint`、`DeleteWorkerEndpoint`。

兼容历史任务码，例如 `LIFECYCLE_MAGIC_PAY_ORDER_CALLBACK_CREATE`，但推荐使用 `CreateInstance`
parameters.name: task_code

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default value: `100`. Valid values: `1` to `100`
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 下一页 token，首次查询不传
parameters.name: next_token

Items.description_en: The returned list. The `items` array may contain multiple tasks with the same `taskCode`
Items.description_zh: 返回是列表，`items` 里可能有多个同一 `taskCode` 的任务
